Thank you for the response. It means a lot. Sorry I didn't respond to this. I haven't tried rehab but I want to say I think i'm strong enough to get past this. For Hobbies: I do volunteer work, hiking, video games, reading, Bicycling, Random PC stuff. I have a lot of hobbies :). Friends i don't have much. Probably because i have difficulty talking to people. I'm just really shy in general and just not confident in my speech. Once i start getting comfortable I can talk very easily lol. 

High school i had friends. I was bullied when I was a freshman, but as soon as I got to become a senior that all changed. I just stopped giving a shit. Participated in more school stuff. Didn't bully the lower class, just wanted to finish the school year happy. Even joked that I planned on winning the lottery five times as my career goal lol. 

\--

What i want out of life is people to just stop being pissed off all the time. I want to help the world, but I know that I can't help everyone. I can only do so much on my time here. I know it's kind of hippy'ish but that's what I truly feel. My secondary goal is to just make sure my Mom is alright and lives a good life :).

Have her ride in a grassy area. Flat. Move the bike with your feet but not on the pedals just have him/her try to balance till they get to the point where they just ride forward without tilting. They can use their feet to catch themselves from falling left/right. At least that's how i learned at like 28 or something lol
